📰 Public USB Ports Threat Analysis by FCC & CISA

The FCC and CISA warn that free public USB charging stations expose mobile devices to juice jacking, where malicious hardware exploits dual-purpose power cables to siphon data and push malware. Understanding the data-line vulnerability and deploying proper hardware countermeasures are critical for travel security hygiene.

📅 10 Oct 2026 | Source: FCC & Cybersecurity Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
